book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Bamii ba woŋ biih fɛ Jiso jo bvuŋga fo
Lɛ nyu juu chimi Jiso yɛyi bamii, wu ka feeji saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo bo le fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo, mo bamii ba sage woŋ to,
bo biih wu le lɛ, “Gɛh sɛ̂ɛŋ bee mu wù nya wo bvuŋga lɛ wo gêe mwɛɛ munɛ? Nya yɛɛŋ bvuŋga bvuyu wo le?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Mɛ tɛ nlé mbîi bɛŋ fiɛɛ. Bɛŋ sɛɛŋ mɛne mɛɛse.
Bvuŋga bvù Joŋ gɛ̀ leese bamii yu a joo gɛ̀ ja fɛwe noo gɛ̀ nya muh wu wuŋ le?”

content: Bo mo bo koo nchvuuŋ lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Bee chvuse lɛ gɛ̀ nya Nyo, wu biih bee le laa gɛ̀ ge la lɛ fɛ bee bɛɛŋ Joŋ le la?
Bee chvuse lɛ gɛ̀ nya muh wu wuŋ, bamii bachii tume bee bɛ ata, nje bo gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ lɛ le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ Joŋ gɛ̀ bee muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo.”
Noo, bo mo bo chvuu lɛ, “Gɛ bee kee muh wu gɛ̀ nya gɛ.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Tu gɛ mɛ nyu nsɛɛŋ tɛ bɛŋ muh wù nya bvuŋga mɛne lɛ ŋgêe mwɛɛ munɛ yu gɛ.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune bamii ba bo gɛ̀ gɛlɛ mwɛne
Jiso mo wu ja wu ma ŋgaŋ bamii le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh mu gɛ̀ lɛŋ mwɛ wu muntaŋ mu mbvuuŋ. Wu gɛɛ mwɛ kwɛɛ bamii le, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ kituŋ kimi le, wu gɛɛŋ wu che yo wesee.

Kife kì ba to ba kege muntaŋ gɛ̀ to ki kojɛ, wu tuŋ mwa ye wu lɛme lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu fi mwe muntaŋ. Wu gɛɛŋ, bamii baa ba wu gɛ̀ gɛlɛ mwɛ wu muntaŋ kwɛɛ bo le, bo suŋ lo wu, bo kuŋ bɛ wu, wu tu jiŋ chiaaŋ chiaaŋ.
Muh wɛɛ ka wu tuŋ mwa ye wu lɛme wumu, bo ka bo suŋ wuwɛɛ, bo choosɛ lo wu, bo kuŋ wu, wu tu jiŋ chiaaŋ chiaaŋ.
Wu ka wu tuŋ wumu kintɛde, bo juŋsɛ wu, bo noŋ wu akfuuŋ.
Muh wu mwɛ wu muntaŋ kwɛɛ kwajɛ lɛ, ‘Nlé ŋgê nɛɛ? Nlé ntuŋ wa mɛɛse nyume mwa yaŋ wu le fitele fiaŋ. Segemu bo gɛɛŋ bo gvuuŋ wu.’
Geenɛ bamii baa ba wu gɛ̀ gɛlɛ mwɛ kwɛɛ bo le bo yɛŋ wu le, bo nchvuuŋ nchvuuŋ lɛbolɛbo lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njibvushɛ bvu muh wu mwɛ kfunɛ. Bee yuuyɛ wu bee mo be jo mwɛ kfunɛ.’
Bo mo bo koo wu, bo bvusɛ mwɛne kwɛɛ bo yuuyɛ.”

content: No Jiso ma noo, wu mo wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ muh wu mwɛ kwɛɛ le wu to wu ge nɛɛ bɛ bamii baa?
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ wu lé wu gê wu tô wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo bamii bayu, wu gɛɛ mwɛ kwɛɛ nyu wa bamii bamu le.”

content: No bamii yu noo, bo kajɛ lo lɛ, “Nyo lôŋsɛ lo.”
Jiso bijɛ bo nɛɛ, wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Tu finɛ fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le jɛme lɛ la, fi le lɛ,
‘Tɛdɛ chiyu chiɛɛ chì bamii ba joone gɛ̀ faŋ,
gɛ̀ kaasɛ chi tu tɛdɛ chi buu chi yeh?’
Tɛdɛ chiyu chinɛ le chi chì muh gwe yu wu chiaafɛ lo, chi gwe yi muh le, chi baajɛ lo mwɛdɛ.”

content: Mbilɛ kune nooŋ ŋwa

No Jiso ma ŋgaŋ wunɛ nɛ, bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bo goone lɛ bo koo wu kife kɛɛ le. Bo gɛ̀ goone ki bo koo wu nje bo gɛ̀ kee lɛ wu gɛ̀ ma ŋgaŋ wɛɛ nyu bo le, geenɛ bo faane bamii.

Bo tu bo bii bikaa bie le, bo ke bamii, bo tuŋ bo gɛɛŋ bo keeyi wu, bo buuse lɛ bo le bamii ba chaaŋ. Bo gɛ̀ gee noo ki bo yu fiɛɛ jwe we le, bo mo bo koo wu bo nya chiaaŋ yi muh wù sage kimbe kì Lum kɛɛ le.
Bamii bayu mo bo ja bo biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, bee kee lɛ mwɛɛ munɛ mù wo jɛme mo mù wo yɛyi le mu kooji, gɛ wo jiiŋe jise chi muh gɛ. Wo yɛyi nchiɛɛŋ nyu fiɛɛ fì Nyo goone lɛ bamii gêe.
Bee mo bee biide lɛ laa, nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ bee laaŋe ŋwa Kaisa Nfoŋ wu Lum le?”
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo wɛɛne bɛ fi, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ tô bɛ danale wu mumwaa n'yɛŋ.

content: ” Bo to bɛ wu, wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Kikwɛɛ kinɛ kì le yu le ki yɛɛŋ, jee chinɛ le chi yɛɛŋ lɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le ki Kaisa, jee le tɛ che.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ nyâa Kaisa le fiɛɛ fì le fi Kaisa, bɛŋ nyâa Nyo le fì le fi Nyo.”

content: Bamii baa yu fi fuuŋsɛ bo, bo mɛ gɛh jwe wuchile bo ka kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ fì bo koo wu yu a bamii jii gɛ, antɛnɛɛ a mwɛɛ mù wu gɛ̀ jɛme le.
Mbilɛ kune bu yi kwe le
Bamii bamu ŋgoo yi Basadushii le gɛ̀ ja bo to fɛ Jiso le. Basadushii banɛ gɛ̀ bee bamii ba gɛ̀ duu lɛ gɛ bamii nyu bo ge bo bu yi kwe le gɛ.
Bo biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, Musɛ gɛ̀ saŋ a nchi wese le lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nɛ muh kɛme kwɛse wu kwe njɛ bɛ wu le bo boo mwa sɛŋ,
tu mwa bwee kɛme ki wu gɛ̂ɛ kwɛse wuyu,
bɛ wu boo booŋ a jee chi ŋkfu mwa bwee le.’

content: Mɛɛse, booŋ ba muh mu gɛ̀ bee bvusooshwi, mwa wù ŋgamu gɛ̀ kɛme kwɛse, wu kwe bɛ kwɛɛ kɛme gɛ mwa gɛ.
Mwa wù gɛ̀ bii wu le gɛɛ kwɛse wɛɛ, wu kwe tɛ mwa sɛŋ.
Wù gɛ̀ ka bii wu le, ka wu gɛɛ tɛ kwɛse wɛɛ, wu kwe tɛ mwa sɛŋ. Fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ noo bɛ booŋ ba bvusooshwi baa bachii, muh bo le baaŋ boo gɛ mwa bɛ kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ.
Ajiŋ ayu kwɛse wɛɛ kwe tɛ.
No bamii ba bvusooshwi bayu gɛ̀ jo kwɛse wɛɛ bachii, lé gê doo nyûme sege bamii bude yi kwe le, wù nyu kwɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Yi kiŋkfuuŋ ki abɛŋ le, bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse le bo taashi bvuguu, bamii ka nyaa booŋ bamii taashi bvuguu bɛ bo.
Geenɛ, bamii ba le ba kojɛ ki bo kɛme kijusɛ yi woŋ wu too le sege bo kaasɛ bo bu yi kwe le, gɛ bo nyu bo ka bo taashi bvuguu gɛ, bamii baaŋ gɛ bo ka bo nyaa booŋ bo taashi bvuguu gɛ.
Gɛ bo baaŋ bo ka bo kweeyɛ gɛ, nje bo lé bo gê bo nyû wa njɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo. Bo lé bo tô bo nyûme wa booŋ ba Nyo, nje bo lé bo kâasɛ wa bo bu yi kwe le.

Nchiɛɛŋ wɛɛ le lɛ Musɛ kibɛɛ gɛ̀ yuusɛ wa bamii, no bo lé bo gê bo kâasɛ bo bu yi kwe le, no wu gɛ̀ saŋ wa kune kite ki mbiaŋ kì wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ ki bɛde. Wu tɛŋe Tada kijusɛ ki ŋwa kiyu le lɛ wu le Nyo wu Ablaham, bɛ Nyo wu Asik mo Nyo wu Yakob.
Wu nɛ tɛŋe noo, tu baŋkfu banɛ le bamii ba baaŋ yu, gɛ Nyo nyume Nyo wu baŋkfu gɛ, wu le Nyo wu bamii ba baaŋ yu, nje fɛ Nyo le, bamii bachii ba le fo le ba wuŋe.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo, bo bɛɛŋsɛ wu bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, wo le wo chvuu chuule.”
Gɛh noo, muh ka wu moŋ lo wu biih wu fiɛɛ gɛ.
Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, le mwa yɛɛŋ
Jiso mo wu ja wu biih fie bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ bo tu bo duu lɛ, Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka le mwa Nfoŋ Dabi?
Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ Dabi kibɛɛ gɛ̀ bee wu saŋ a Ŋwa wu Yuusɛ le lɛ,
‘Tada Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ Tada waŋ le lɛ,
wu shii a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le,
gɛɛŋ bu sege nlé ŋgê ŋgiiŋsɛ bamii be ba kimbanɛ,
wu tomɛ bikaa bie yi bo le, njɛ kitege ki bikaa.’
Nɛ Dabi tɛŋe wu lɛ Tada we, fi ka fi jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ wu tu wù nyu mwa ye?”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ bamii yɛ̂ne kune bamii ba duunyi banchi
Jiso mo wu ja wu tu wu jɛme wa nyu booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, bamii bachii yuge. Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne kune bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo. Bo koŋe ki bo nooŋ nyu bikuŋ bì ndefe bo jiɛnyi bɛ bi, bo koŋe lɛ bamii yɛ̂ɛse bo le manjuu ma ba kame chi waaŋ bɛ ŋgvunɛ. Bo koŋe ki bo shiide binta bì baaŋ baaŋ yéh yi buunɛ le. Sege bo lé bo gɛ̂ɛŋ fɛ ŋka le, bo koŋe ki bo shiide nyu fwe.
Bo shiishi bakwɛŋkfu, bo lɛɛde bɛ bo, bo fii yéh bɛ mwɛɛ muboo, bo buuse bo bɛ chibuunɛ chì ndefe. Wuboo ŋgɛ lé wu gê wu yâ lo.”
